fields.description: Page four of the Saturday, September 29, 1934 issue of MIAMI LIFE. Includes an "Editors Mail" section with letters discussing health and sanitation conditions in Miami-area tourist camps and concerns about malaria; local columns and short items about Miami social life and liquor-related incidents; notices promoting "Miami Life Day" and merchant promotions; entertainment listings and advertisements (theatre calendar, wrestling at Biscayne Fronton, Miami Beach venues), and local business advertisements.
